intro: Pages for writers on Mac is Apple's word processor, and the core writing tools stay free in 2026. Pages 15.4 is the current Mac release, and it needs macOS 15.6 or later. This guide covers which version to install, how to start from a template, how to export for editors, known problems, and where Lazur fits into a writing session.
tldr: Core writing in Pages stays free. Premium templates and some extras need Creator Studio at $12.99 a month or $129 a year in the US.
Check your version under Pages > About Pages. Pages 15.4 needs macOS 15.6 or later.
Export to PDF for final review and DOC for editors. Word compatibility is partial, and OpenDocument is not supported.
Slow opening and a copy and paste bug have both been reported. Test with your own files before a deadline.
Lazur helps by voice. Hold fn to dictate at the cursor, and hold ⌥⌘ to ask about the screen. It does not click for you.

blocks.text: Which Pages you get on a Mac in 2026

Apple split Pages in two this year. On January 28, 2026, it released a separate Creator Studio edition, version 15.1. The new app is internally named Pages Creator Studio.app. The older app was updated to version 14.5 and told it will receive no new features. On April 13, 2026, Apple removed the old Mac builds from the App Store. New users now see only the Creator Studio version.

If you already bought the old app, you can re-download it from your purchase history. That copy will not get new features, though. For most writers the right choice is the 15.x edition, because that is where new work lands.

Core work stays free. Apple says Pages, Keynote and Numbers remain free for everyone. You can create, view, edit and collaborate in real time at no cost. The Creator Studio subscription adds premium templates, a library of royalty-free photos and graphics, and intelligence features.

rows: Included, with iCloud files up to 4GB
blocks.caption: Split as reported by Apple and MacRumors. Check Apple's pricing page for current terms.

blocks.text: Not every Pages feature is labeled clearly. Screen View arrived on September 29, 2026, and reports do not say whether it needs a subscription. Apple's pricing page does not label each tool as subscriber only. Read the feature list before you pay.

blocks.title: Do not pay by accident
blocks.text: TidBITS reported that many users assumed they now had to pay for apps that used to be free. Open Apple's Creator Studio page, read the list, and decide before you start a trial.
Check your version and macOS before you start

Start with the version. Choose Pages > About Pages. You want a number that starts with 15. The current release is 15.4, dated September 29, 2026. It requires macOS 15.6 or later. If your Mac runs an older macOS, update it first, or Pages will not run.

items: Open Pages > About Pages and confirm the version starts with 15.
If the version is too old, update macOS from System Settings > General > Software Update.
Open File > New once to check that templates load.
Write the version number in your project notes, so every editor uses the same one.

blocks.text: Version matters for collaborators. A TidBITS commenter reported that copy and paste did not work between Pages 14.5 and 15.1 documents. TidBITS said a later update did not fix it. Keep everyone on the same edition for the life of a project, and you avoid that risk.
Start a project with the right template

To open a template, click New Document or choose File > New. Scroll to a category in the template chooser. Double-click the template you want. Apple's guide lists Basic, Reports, Books, Stationery and envelopes as categories. Essay and School Newsletter are named templates in the chooser.

Set a default if you always start the same way. Open Pages > Settings > General and turn on the Use template option. New documents then open from the template you choose. For a one-off, hold Option and choose File > New from Template Chooser to pick a different template.

blocks.text: Here is a worked example. You have a school essay due. Pick Essay, type the title, and save the file in a folder that your backup tool watches. Write inside that one file. Do not save a new copy for every edit, because copies make it hard to know which one has the fixes.

Delete the sample text before you paste in your own. Leftover sample text is easy to miss in a long draft. Editors notice it at the worst possible moment, usually after they have already read the first page.
Write long drafts without losing your place

Pages has a full-screen mode that helps long drafts. Press ⌃⌘F to turn full screen on or off. After Pages 5, full screen does not hide the side panes for you. You have to hide them manually. The page thumbnails pane also no longer opens by itself.

9to5Mac reported that Pages added a Screen View on September 29, 2026. Apple describes it as optimized for reading and focused writing. Test it on a draft you already know. Check whether your copy shows it before you plan around it.

Use the keys you already know. Find text with ⌘F. Undo with ⌘Z and redo with ⇧⌘Z. Pages has allowed non-contiguous text selection since version 14.0, released April 15, 2024. Use it to compare passages that sit far apart.

items: Export a PDF before a big cut, so you can compare the old version.
Keep one working file, and name it with the date and purpose.
Keep notes in comments or a separate section, not in the middle of your prose.
Use ⌘Z before you retype a paragraph from memory.
Save to a folder that your backup tool watches.

blocks.text: Dictate and get voice help in Pages

Lazur dictates into Pages. Hold fn, speak, and let go. Clean, formatted text lands at the cursor in the app you are using. The same key works in other apps, so you can keep one habit across your work.
Dictation is good for a first draft. Polish still needs your eyes. Check names, numbers and quotes after each spoken passage. Dictated text can look right and still carry a wrong name.

Many writers draft faster by talking than by typing, but the gap varies by person. Test your own speed with the [speaking versus typing test](/tools/speaking-vs-typing-test) and the [typing speed test](/tools/typing-speed-test). Then decide when to speak and when to type.

Lazur also helps with what is on screen. Hold ⌥⌘ and ask about anything you see. Lazur answers out loud. Ask where a control is, and Lazur draws a circle and a label around it. Ask how to do a task, and Lazur guides you one click at a time, waiting for each click.
Lazur does not click buttons, edit files, or operate Pages for you. You do the clicks. Lazur tells you which one comes next and waits. That matters when you need to keep control of a document.

Snippets, a personal dictionary and clipboard slots handle repeated work. Store your citation format, your email signature and the spelling of names that dictation keeps getting wrong. Add them once, then reuse them in every draft.
Export, Word files and collaborators

Pages exports to PDF, EPUB and DOC. It imports only some Word documents, including Office Open XML files. Pages does not support OpenDocument, as of September 2026. Compatibility with Word is partial, so plan a check step before you send.

Send a PDF when the layout is final and no one must edit it. Send a DOC when an editor needs to change the text. Open the DOC in Word or another app before you send it. Check tables, headings and comments. Things shift during conversion.

blocks.text: Real-time collaboration is part of the free app. MacRumors reported that Creator Studio subscribers get iCloud collaboration on files up to 4GB. If your file is larger, check the limit before a team project starts.

A standard Creator Studio plan can be shared with up to five other people through Family Sharing. Student and educator plans cannot be shared. Students and educators pay $2.99 a month or $29.99 a year, according to Apple. Ask your co-writers whether anyone in the group already pays.
Mail merge for letters and lists

Mail merge is back in Pages. Pages 5.0 removed mail merge and RTF support. Pages 12.1, released June 21, 2022, restored mail merge. Pages 6.1, released March 27, 2017, restored RTF. Mail merge helps when you send the same letter to a list of people.

Test a merge on a short list before you send. Check that every name and address fills in. Read one finished letter out loud. A mistake in a merge goes to every recipient, so the test matters more than it does for a single letter.
Known problems and workarounds

Slow opening is a recurring complaint. A 2023 Apple Community user said Pages 13 on macOS Monterey took up to a minute to open a document in My Documents. The same file opened faster on a Mojave MacBook Pro.

A community reply blamed limited RAM, Spotlight indexing and competing apps. It suggested closing other apps and offered no other fix beyond updating. Treat the report as one user's experience on an older version, and test your own Mac.

The copy and paste bug is a single report too. A TidBITS commenter said copy and paste did not work between Pages 14.5 and 15.1 documents. TidBITS said a later update did not fix it. Another commenter found copying worked when both documents were open in 15.1.

items: Open both documents in the same Pages edition, ideally 15.1 or later.
Copy the text into a plain text file first, then paste from that file.
Save a PDF of the old document before you change anything.
Report the problem through Apple's feedback channel so the bug stays on record.

blocks.text: Pricing confusion and App Store ratings

After the Creator Studio launch, the Pages App Store rating fell from 4.6 stars to 2.5, according to TidBITS. That figure is a February 2026 snapshot. Check the App Store for current ratings before you decide anything from it.

TidBITS said many users assumed they now had to pay for apps that used to be free. Users also reported seeing Creator Studio branding and subscription prompts. Read the App Store page and Apple's pricing page before you install.
Apple lists Creator Studio at $12.99 a month or $129 a year in the US, after a free trial. Check Apple's pricing page for your region, since prices can change.
Where Lazur fits in a Pages session

Lazur is a voice assistant for the Mac that lives in the notch. Hold ⌥⌘ to ask about anything on screen. It listens and looks at the screen only while you hold the shortcut. Lazur is not a plugin or add-in for any app, and it has no partnerships with app makers.

Use Lazur for the work around Pages. Ask it how to find a template. Hold fn to dictate your draft at the cursor. Ask it to draft a reply to a comment, and it types the text where you want it. Ask it to research a Pages problem, and it runs in its own Chrome tabs and returns a summary and a report.
Lazur does not replace your judgment on a sentence. Read every draft before you keep it. Lazur drafts and types text, and you decide what stays in the document.

Privacy matters with a tool that sees your screen. Lazur sends audio and a screenshot to AI providers to answer you. Lazur says those are not stored. Content is never used to train AI models. Read the full policy on the download page before you install.

For Pages specifics, see the [Pages for Mac guide](/apps/pages). You can compare plans on the [pricing page](/pricing), then [download Lazur](/download) to try it on your Mac. Lazur has a free Pro trial that needs no credit card.
Mistakes writers make in Pages

items: Writing before choosing a template. Pick the layout first, or you will move text around later.
Naming files final, then final again. Date every version instead.
Trusting a Word export without a read through. Conversion moves things around.
Skipping the version check. Old and new editions do not always share files well.
Leaving sample text in a template. Editors notice it at the worst time.
Assuming a feature stays free without checking the feature list first.

blocks.text: Blank pages slow many writers down before the first sentence. If that is your problem, start by talking. The [blank page guide](/for/developers/problems/why-writers-block-blank-page-causes) covers causes and free fixes.
Who should use Pages and who should pick something else

Pages suits writers who work on a Mac, keep files local and need clean templates for essays, reports and books. It fits people who export to PDF for review. It is a weaker choice when your team relies on OpenDocument files or on Word-only features.

If your editors live in Word, read the [Word guide for writers on Mac](/for/writers/word). If your team shares documents in Google Docs, read the [Google Docs guide for writers on Mac](/for/writers/google-docs). Both explain where each app is strongest.
Next steps

items: Open Pages > About Pages and confirm you are on 15.x.
Pick a template from File > New that matches the job you have today.
Set a default template in Pages > Settings > General if you start the same way each time.
Export one PDF and one DOC from a test file before you send anything real.
Try Lazur for dictation and screen help, starting with the free Pro trial on the pricing page.

faq.question: Is Pages for Mac free in 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, for core work. Apple says Pages, Keynote and Numbers remain free for everyone, and you can create, view, edit and collaborate in real time at no cost. Creator Studio costs $12.99 a month or $129 a year in the US and adds premium templates and other extras. Check Apple's pricing page for your region.

faq.question: Which version of Pages should I install on a Mac?
faq.answer: Install the Creator Studio edition, which is version 15.x. Pages 15.4 is the current release, dated September 29, 2026, and it needs macOS 15.6 or later. The old 14.x app no longer gets new features, and Apple removed it from the App Store on April 13, 2026.

faq.question: How do I open a template in Pages on Mac?
faq.answer: Click New Document or choose File > New. Scroll to a category in the template chooser, such as Basic, Reports, Books, Stationery or Essay. Double-click the template to open it. To make one template your default, open Pages > Settings > General and turn on Use template.

faq.question: Can Pages open Word documents?
faq.answer: Partly. Pages imports some Word documents, including Office Open XML files. It exports to DOC, so editors can open your work. It does not support OpenDocument as of September 2026. Check tables, styles and comments after every import or export.

faq.question: Why is Pages slow to open on my Mac?
faq.answer: One 2023 Apple Community user reported that Pages 13 took up to a minute to open a file. A community reply blamed limited RAM, Spotlight indexing and competing apps. Update Pages, close other apps, and test a fresh copy of the file. The reply offered no other fix.

faq.question: Can I dictate into Pages with my voice?
faq.answer: Yes. Hold fn in Pages and Lazur dictates clean, formatted text at the cursor. Dictation is unlimited on both paid Lazur plans. Lazur does not click buttons or edit your file for you. It types text where your cursor sits, and you decide what to keep.

faq.question: Is Lazur a plugin for Pages?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is not a plugin or add-in for any app, and it has no partnerships with app makers. It is a voice assistant for the Mac. It sees your screen only while you hold the shortcut, and it guides you one click at a time.
